title: Certifying a Sufficient Gaussian Dependence Regime for Learned Weighted FDR Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.33892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning hypothesis weights from informative auxiliary data can improve the power of multiple testing. Even when the weights are learned independently of the tests, the validity of weighted Benjamini-Hochberg depends on their joint distribution. We use reference observations to certify a sufficient dependence condition for one-sided Gaussian tests. An intersection-union test of uncertain correlation signs determines whether to apply weighted Benjamini-Hochberg or a prespecified fallback at an adjusted level. Under conditional separation of certification and testing, the procedure controls the false discovery rate (FDR) for every Gaussian correlation matrix satisfying the stated sampling assumptions and weight constraints. We establish a boundary obstruction to uniform certification and matching minimax sample-size bounds for worst-case pair sets and the all-pairs problem. translated_title: 为学习型加权FDR控制认证充分的高斯相依性条件
translated_abstract: 从信息丰富的辅助数据中学习假设权重可以提升多重检验的功效。即使权重是独立于检验而学习的，加权Benjamini-Hochberg方法的有效性仍取决于权重与检验的联合分布。我们利用参考观测来认证单侧高斯检验的一个充分相依性条件。一个针对不确定相关符号的交集-并集检验决定是应用加权Benjamini-Hochberg方法，还是在调整后的水平上应用预先指定的后备方法。在认证与检验实现条件分离的前提下，该程序对每一个满足所述抽样假设和权重约束的高斯相关矩阵都能控制错误发现率（FDR）。我们还建立了统一认证的边界性障碍，并针对最坏情形配对集合和全配对问题给出了匹配的极小极大样本量界。
tldr: 该论文提出利用参考观测认证单侧高斯检验的充分相依性条件，使学习得到的加权Benjamini-Hochberg程序在满足该条件时能严格控制错误发现率（FDR），并给出了匹配的极小极大样本量界。
en_tdlr: This paper certifies a sufficient Gaussian dependence condition via reference observations under which learned weighted Benjamini-Hochberg procedures control FDR, establishing matching minimax sample-size bounds for certification.
